newsitem.title: FRANCE: FIGURE SKATING-SIX PERFECT MARKS FOR GRITSCHUK AND PLATOV.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-SIX PERFECT MARKS FOR GRITSCHUK AND PLATOV.

text.p: Oksana Gritschuk and Evgeny Platov collected six perfect marks of 6.0 for artistry from the nine judges for their tango as they strengthened their ice dance lead at the European figure skating championships on Thursday.

It was almost certainly the largest score of 6.0s awarded at an international championship since Britons Jayne Torville and Christopher Dean received 12 6.0s for their Bolero free dance at the 1984 Olympics in Sarajevo, including all nine for artistry.

The Russian world and Olympic title holders, who changed coaches from Natalia Linichuk to Tatiana Tarasova just over a month ago, are heavily favoured to retain their European title in the free skating final on Friday night.
Team mates Anjelika Krylova and Oleg Ovsiannikov remained in second place.
Sophie Moniotte and Pascal Lavanchy moved up to third by overtaking French team mates Marina Anissina and Gwendal Peizerate.
